name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the previous context and maintains the topic of conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the degree to which the response encourages further conversation and invites additional input from the other participant.

name: Informative Value
description: Evaluates how much new information or interesting facts are provided in the response, enhancing the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Checks the logical flow and clarity of the response, ensuring it makes sense within the context of the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in providing unique perspectives or ideas.
